To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
gonadotropin (FSH) directly regulates pluripotent stem (VSELs and Oct4B+ epithelial, stromas and endothelial cells) in mouse uterus.
the uterine stem cells are activated by gonadotropins and steroid hormones and are involved in endometrial growth and differentiation.
gonadotropins and steroid hormones regulate very small embryonic like stem cells in adult endometrium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of VSELs in adult uterus by gonadotropin hormone (FSH) as well as by steroid hormones (E, P).
stem cells in the adult endometrium and their regulation by gonadotropins and steroid hormones.
stem cells in uterine endome-trium, their regulation, differentiation and role in endometrial repair/remodeling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the uterine stem cells are the target of gonadotropins and ovarian steroids, which regulate the stem cell niche in the endometrial stroma and regulate the proliferation and differentiation of the endometrial stem/progenitor cell compartment.
FSH, P, E and their receptors are expressed by VSELs in adult endometrium and regulate stem/progenitor cell function.
gonadotropins and steroids directly stimulate VSELs in adult uterus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FSH and steroid hormones regulate uterine VSELS in a tissue specific manner and that the stem cell activation is more prominent after P or FSH than E.
FSH, P and E have direct stimulatory effects of uterine VSELS.
VSELs exist, are regulated and undergo proliferation/differentiaion in adult mouse uterus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VSELs are present in the endometrium of adult mouse uterus and are activated by physiological doses of FSH and P.
the uterine stem cell pool is regulated by gonadotropins and steroid hormones.
the stem cells in the uterus are regulated by hormones, and that this may have implications for fertility, and for uterine health in general.
